department: Agriculture Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
summary: Income support for farmer families in Andhra Pradesh: Rs 20,000 a year, made of Rs 6,000 from the central PM-KISAN scheme plus Rs 14,000 from the state, paid in three instalments to an Aadhaar-linked bank account.

eligibility.who: Eligible farmer families; sources mention small, marginal and tenant farmers
eligibility.pm_kisan_link: Rules sit on top of PM-KISAN; being a current PM-KISAN beneficiary appears to be needed (one source)
eligibility.beneficiaries_note: About 47 lakh farmers were reported eligible after e-KYC (2025 report)

benefits.first_instalment: Rs 5,000 state + Rs 2,000 PM-KISAN = Rs 7,000 (reported for the 2026-27 cycle, released about 20/06/2026)
benefits.payment_mode: Direct transfer to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account

documents.name: Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents.why: Money is paid by direct transfer
documents.if_missing: Open an account and link it to Aadhaar

documents.name: PM-KISAN registration details
documents.why: Eligibility depends on being a PM-KISAN beneficiary
documents.if_missing: Ask at the Rythu Seva Kendra / agriculture office

documents.name: e-KYC (verification)
documents.why: Farmers must complete e-KYC to receive payments
documents.if_missing: Complete it at your village agriculture or secretariat centre

documents.name: Land or tenancy details (for tenant farmers)
documents.if_missing: Ask the agriculture department what is accepted

steps: Check that you are a PM-KISAN beneficiary and that your e-KYC is complete
There appears to be no separate application; eligible farmers are identified from the records
Check your name and payment status on the Annadata Sukhibhava portal
Money is credited in instalments; the state share and the PM-KISAN instalment usually arrive together
If your name is missing, contact the agriculture department or your village secretariat

dates.latest_instalment: First instalment of 2026-27 released about 20/06/2026; previous one reported around March 2026

sources: UNI and PTI news reports (June 2026 and July 2025)
